descriptionText: Continental Athletic ConferenceVisit The United States Sports University is America's only freestanding university dedicated exclusively to sports education, preparing students for careers in sport management, coaching, exercise science, and athletic leadership.Sponsored Sports include: Men's Soccer, Women's Soccer, Women's Volleyball, Cross Country, Baseball, Softball, Track & Field

name: Georgia Southern East Georgia(Swainsboro)
descriptionText: Continental Athletic ConferenceVisit East Georgia State College(knows as the Golden Eagles) is a public institution within the University System of Georgia focused on providing affordable, accessible higher education. With a growing academic portfolio and commitment to student achievement, the college offers opportunities for students to succeed both in the classroom and through NAIA athletics.

name: Nevada State
descriptionText: Great Southwest Athletic ConferenceVisit The Nevada State athletics teams are called the Scorpions.Nevada State University opened in 2002 as the only four-year, teaching-focused institution in the Nevada System of Higher Education, situated between the state’s research universities and community colleges. The university launched athletics in July 2025 with Women’s Flag Football and Men’s Track & Field, competing as an independent institution for the first season. The university joined the NAIA and the GSAC in July 2026, coinciding with the addition of Women’s and Men’s Cross Country and Women’s Track & Field. The athletics department plans to add additional sports in the coming years with a commitment to building steadily, responsibly, and with long-term success in mind. Current Sports:Women’s Cross CountryWomen’s Flag FootballWomen’s Track & Field (Indoor/Outdoor)Men’s Cross CountryMen’s Track & Field (Indoor/Outdoor)
